title: Odile and the Deadline
author: Ansel Oyelaran
blurb: Ulyana Ashgrove, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
